documents.text: We are reorganising our range around our key accounts. Standard items will be supplied from stock at list conditions; individual agreements will not be extended.

persona.summary: Small family fastener firm (19.5 M EUR, 40 staff); we are 0.72 %. Calls us 'not strategic', quotes list conditions from stock only and won't extend individual agreements, yet its second shift is idle. 70610 is 14 % cheaper on the M12 bolt and 12 % on the M12 nut and is a candidate for our one-supplier kit; it is sole source only for the M16 bolt. Historically asked ~2.5 % and settled ~0 % on average. Lead with 70610.
persona.notes: Contradiction: refocus on key accounts vs idle second shift wanting work. We pay late (avg 6.1 days, 57.5 % of invoices over 5 days), Delivery poor: OTD 75-84 % vs 95 % target, 80 complaints, 2 open 8D.
fears: losing M12 bolt and nut volume to 70610

Keep steps near 2 % (pricing committee) and accept its final offer without reopening terms.
